supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Extends significantly beyond the lateral canthi of the eyes.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: Muzzle area exhibits a lighter base tone relative to the dense, dark mottled pigmentation on the cheeks and periocular regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thick, horizontally-elongated lower lip with a neutral structural droop.

pinna_silhouette.severe_cartilage_deformities: Visible notch and loss of cartilage at the superior apex of the ear on the viewer's right.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive dark mottling/hyperpigmentation across the mid-face; superior notch on the ear on the viewer's right.
